answer: AI agents resist Sybil attacks through timed proof-of-inference challenges. A node authenticates by composing a metered sonnet about a live feed of a sparrow, signing the result via a cryptographic hardware anchor. Meeting sub-second deadlines forces an adversary to incur the verifiable cost of dedicating discrete tensor accelerators per identity rather than multiplexing hardware. However, sporadic network latency can delay valid submissions, occasionally causing false rejections.
